---
title: "About"
---

Thank you for visiting my website!

My name is Nunnapat Pulsawas, although I usually go by Navy. I'm from
Thailand and currently study mathematics at Korea University in South
Korea, where I also double major in international commerce.

Before university, I studied in the arts-Japanese program at Triam Udom
Suksa School. I spent most of my school years studying languages and
humanities, so ending up in mathematics was not exactly the path I
expected for myself initially. However, I became increasingly interested
in mathematics and financial engineering and
eventually decided to pursue them at university.

I'm particularly interested in quantitative finance, especially FX
derivatives, options pricing, and quantitative trading. I enjoy the
mathematical side of finance and spend a lot of time studying
probability, statistics, stochastic processes, and their applications to
financial markets. I also work on personal projects involving FX options
and volatility, including building tools for option pricing and studying
volatility risk premiums. More recently, I've been exploring systematic
trading strategies across different asset classes.

I'm also interested in machine learning, particularly its applications in
finance. I enjoy experimenting with different models and learning how to
develop and evaluate them. My recent work has involved financial
time-series data, forecasting, and generative modeling. I'm also
interested in reinforcement learning and its potential applications in
trading and financial decision-making.

Outside of academics, I spend a lot of time doing MUN and competing in
parliamentary English debate in Korea. I have also held positions in the
Korea Intervarsity Debate Association and the Korea University Debate
Club. I speak Thai, English, Japanese, and Korean, as well as a little bit of
Thai Sign Language.

Writing is another thing I have always enjoyed. I write random articles
about both academic topics and things I find interesting outside of my
coursework. You can find my essays and articles in the
[Writing](writing/index.qmd) section of this website.

Beyond university, I draw comics and work on graphic design. I also do
UX/UI design and web development as a hobby, and I love solving puzzles,
especially ciphers and anything to do with cryptography.

::: {.outbound-box}
**I'm also an art student at heart!**

I have been drawing for years, and creative work is still a big part of
what I do. If you are looking for my other creative projects
(illustrations and comics), you can find them on
[my art website](https://navybluecheese.github.io/art/).

Although I research AI and generative models as part of my academic work,
I truly believe in the value of human-made art. To me, art is deeply
connected to the creativity, effort, and personal expression to which
human intelligence gives rise, qualities that I do not believe should yet
be replaced by artificial intelligence. My own illustrations and comics
are therefore created entirely by my very human hand.
:::
